verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform, so business hours per number is a fair axis. The evidence only shows adjacent routing features: custom ring orders, call transfers, phone menus, and the Sona AI answering when the team can't. Nothing documents business-hours schedules, open/closed behavior, or holiday handling per number.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
